units.source_text: 我只不过是个观战记者，从所处的地位来说，大竹没有必要特地向我致意，可是他却郑重其事地向我致意了。

en.t: I was merely a reporter watching the match, and given my position, Otake had no need to go out of his way to greet me, yet he did so with formal courtesy.

units.source_text: 这是彼此友好的象征，我的地位也不同了。

en.t: This was a sign of mutual goodwill, and my standing had changed as well.

units.source_text: 我不能只说声“是吗”就不闻不问。

en.t: I could not simply say, "Is that so?" and let the matter pass without asking anything more.
